title: Molecularly engineered zwitterionic‑fluorinated hydrogel electrolyte for durable Ah-level zinc-ion batteries
abstract: Published online: 01 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77562-5 Aqueous zinc-ion batteries promise safe energy storage but suffer from dendrites and side reactions. Here, authors engineer a zwitterionic fluorinated hydrogel electrolyte to suppress these issues, enabling durable, <mark>dendrite</mark> free, Ah-level pouch cells.

abstract: A lightweight compositionally complex alloy Ti45.5V45.5Cr4.5Al4.5 (at.%) was investigated.
